newsitem.title: USA: HealthPlan sees more 97 integration charges.
newsitem.headline: HealthPlan sees more 97 integration charges.

text.p: HealthPlan Services Corp said Monday it expects further improvement in its operating margins as it consolidates facilities in coming months and expects to record additional integration charges in 1997.
The company reported first quarter earnings of about $2.8 millino, or $0.19 a share, after integration charges of nearly $1.4 million.
HealthPlan said additionally that its contract to provide enrollment services for Kentucky's healthcare alliance would expire July 1.
HealthPlan provides marketing, administrative and risk management services for small businesses and large, self-insured organizations.
